name: Cucumber Raita
steps: Wash the cucumber, trim the ends and grate coarsely. If it releases a lot of water, squeeze it gently so the raita stays creamy rather than watery.
Whisk the plain curd in a bowl until smooth. Wash and finely chop the coriander, keeping a small amount aside if you want a garnish.
Fold the cucumber into the curd, then mix in cumin powder and coriander. Stir gently rather than blending, so the cucumber keeps some texture.
Add salt close to serving time, taste and stir again. Keep covered in the refrigerator until needed; if liquid separates, stir it back in gently before serving.
tips: Season near serving time to limit water release.
substitutions: Any substitution changes the recipe: recheck allergies, Jain rules and quantities.
notes: Ingredient costs are estimates. Check local prices before shopping.
